map.基于句子权重算法，自动提取文本关键句子生成摘要: Automatically extract key sentences from text via a sentence-weighting algorithm to generate a summary
map.自动提取文本要点生成摘要。: Automatically extract key points from text to generate a summary.
map.：按句子权重打分后挑选最重要的若干句，权重常由词频、位置与线索词决定。: : score sentences by weight, then pick the most important ones; weight is often determined by word frequency, position, and cue words.
map.：关键词出现次数、是否在段首段尾、是否含「因此/总之」等提示词。: : keyword frequency, whether at paragraph start/end, and whether it contains cue words like "therefore/in summary".
map.：压缩比、信息覆盖率与通顺度。: : compression ratio, information coverage, and fluency.
map.：基于规则的摘要适合快速速览，正式场景仍需人工润色。: : rule-based summaries suit quick overviews; formal scenarios still need human polishing.
map.每个句子的权重分数及维度详情: Weight score and dimension details for each sentence
map.摘要生成器基于 TextRank 简化版算法，通过句子权重分析自动提取文本中的关: The Summary Generator is based on a simplified TextRank algorithm that automatically extracts key sentences from text via sentence-weight analysis to produce a concise summary.
map.快速浏览长文档前先抽取要点句：得到一份概览后再决定是否需要精读全文，节省阅读时间: Before quickly browsing a long document, extract key sentences first: get an overview, then decide whether to read the full text, saving reading time.
map.长文 → 取前 N 句关键句作摘要（非生成式）。: Long text → take the top N key sentences as the summary (non-generative).

map.本工具为抽取式，不重写内容。: This tool is extractive and does not rewrite content.
map.为什么摘要读起来不通顺？: Why does the summary read awkwardly?
map.因为抽取式摘要是「从原文中挑出重要句子原样拼接」，不做改写与连贯性处理，因此句与: Because extractive summaries "pick important sentences from the source and stitch them together" without rewriting or coherence handling, so sentences may lack connection and have dangling references (e.g., "this point"). Its advantage is that it never produces content absent from the source (no hallucinations), suiting fidelity-required scenarios; for fluent prose use a generative summary.

Pure front-end processing, no data upload. An online tool built for developers, runs entirely in the browser; your code never leaves the device.
